name: Sod Hound (BB)

items.name: Crystal Sense 60 feet
items.text: A sod hound can sense crystals or gems within 60 feet.

items.name: Earth Glide
items.text: The sod hound burrows through any earthen matter, including rock. It moves up to 20 feet, leaving no tunnels or signs of its passing.

items.name: Knockdown
items.text: When the sod hound succeeds at its jaws Strike, it can use this action immediately after to attempt to Trip the target. This Trip doesn't apply or count toward the sod hound's multiple attack penalty.

text:
Earth elementals such as sod hounds make excellent bodyguards for spelunkers and are ideal protectors of important subterranean locations. Coming from the Plane of Earth, they often appear in caverns deep underground.

Sod hounds take the form of mossy canines made of packed dirt and pebbles. They can band together with other sod hounds, traveling as a pack.
